verses.text: Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say,
lines: Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up.

verses.text: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
lines: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up,
yet they have not prevailed against me.

verses.text: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.
lines: The plowers plowed on my back.

verses.text: Yahweh is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.
lines: He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

verses.text: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
lines: Let them be disappointed and turned backward,

verses.text: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,
lines: Let them be as the grass on the housetops,
which withers before it grows up,

verses.text: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.
lines: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand,
nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

verses.text: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of Yahweh be on you. We bless you in Yahweh’s name.”
lines: Neither do those who go by say,
“The blessing of Yahweh be on you.
We bless you in Yahweh’s name.”
